name: pi-only-tools
description: Codex-style shell and patch tools with unified Normal, Ask, and Plan modes.

scripts.check: find src -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check dist/index.js
scripts.test: node test/test.mjs && node test/render-lines.test.mjs && node test/entry-registration.test.mjs && node test/plan-store.test.mjs && node test/plan-render.test.mjs && node test/plan-review-dispatch.test.mjs && node test/codex-shell-command.test.mjs && node test/tool-profile-controller.test.mjs && node test/cache-stable-mode.test.mjs && node test/ask-mode.test.mjs && node test/plan-integration.test.mjs && node test/profile-config.test.mjs && node test/profile-matrix.test.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run check
